Specification: This module defines helper and annotation operators for use with the Apalache model checker while remaining compatible with standard TLA+, TLC, and TLAPS. It contains operator definitions, including recursive ones, plus local module instantiations, but no constants, variables, actions over primed state variables, temporal properties, assumptions, or theorems.
